items.summary: Investing.com -- Off-price retailer Ross Stores raised its full-year earnings outlook on Thursday after reporting stronger-than-expected second-quarter sales and profit, helped by robust customer traffic and a refund of tariffs.

items.title: Dow Giant Walmart Sinks To A 9-Month Low; Ross Stores Stock Jumps
items.summary: Walmart raised guidance for the full year early Thursday after beating earnings and revenue estimates for its second quarter. But WMT stock plunged to a nine-month low. Walmart is the world's largest retailer by 2025 sales, according to the National Retail Federation.
